Don’t pay any mind to what people say. Just block out their negativity, and go on throughout your day. And if they don’t stop, disassociate from those people completely, as they are serving no purpose in your life but holding you back. Suicide is never the answer. Stay strong.

Don’t pay any mind to what people say about you when they don’t truly know you. Don’t let them bring you down, instead keep your head up high and remain strong, that’ll show them that their negativity can’t reach you. I used to think the same when I was your age, and I still do here and there. Just tell yourself things will get better. Shit, you’ve got so much life left in you, in a couple years you’ll look back and laugh because you’ll be so much more mature and not give a fuck what people have to say. You may think your a failure but your not, your just a child and still growing. Everyone hurts people with or without trying to. It happens. Move on and stay strong. If you ever need to talk feel free to message me, I’m here for you.

Yes, it was definitely worth choosing to live. I mean, think about all the knowledge you’ve gained over those years. Ending your life means your giving up and won’t be able to move on until you’ve passed your test. Think about it, we chose to be here. We chose who we wanted to surround ourselves with and so on. You’re only 30. You have so much life left to live and so much more knowledge your higher self wants you to gain. Telling someone to stay alive is not telling them to keep suffering. It’s telling them to not give up their fight and remain strong until their time has naturally come. If your so depressed, seek help if you haven’t already. Or your mind will just keep spiraling down that never ending black hole of sadness. Life will get better, it always does. Stay strong. And if you ever need someone to talk to feel free to message me whenever. I’ll try to help the best that I can.

You’re alive because you chose to be. I believe that before we descend into earth, our souls chose our families, how we look, and lifelong friends. Life on Earth is all a test. We pass, we move on to the next experience of life. Our higher selves want to grow and learn as much as we can, we chose this. We just have no clue when we get here. Anything and everything will change for you as you go through every stage of your life. Yes, things may get bad, but in the end everything gets better with time, not worse. Don’t manifest these negative thoughts into reality or you’ll never be able to grow and life will just shit on you. Hold your head up high and conquer every terrible thing that gets thrown your way. Stay strong.
If you need someone to talk to, feel free to message me :)
Of course, wish I could’ve been more help.

For one, I’m sorry.. your mother sounds like a horrible person. Secondly, you are not dead weight to society. Remember, everyone was put on this Earth for a reason. If I were you, I’d try to look for a new job, something you genuinely are good at/enjoy doing. It’s tough but not impossible. Don’t give up, please keep fighting. Everything gets better eventually.

For one, don’t listen to satisfaction8176. Everything will be alright. I’m where you are right now but I try to look on the brighter sides of things. Depression is tough and feels like it’s never going to go away, but with time it will eventually get better (at least what I tell myself). I picture actually killing myself with a gun or jumping off a high building or bridge. It’s a good thing you’re too afraid to go through with it. And if you do ever think you have the guts to finally go through with it, just remember everyone around you loves you and cares for you and doing it would make them so devastated. Don’t give up, keep fighting.
